STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_01501_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_01501_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_01501(
  input clk,
  input reset,
  input EN,                             
  input [2:0] IR,
  input [11:0] AC,
  input LINK,
  input ckFetch, ck1, ck2,
  input stbFetchA, stbFetchB, stb1,
  input irqRq,
  input anyDone,
  output done,
  output rot2ac,
  output ac_ck,
  output clr,
  output ACclr,
  output linkclr,
  output linkcml,
  output link_ck,
  output pc_ck,
  output [11:0] ACGTF,
  output irqOverride
);

reg IE;
reg IEdly1, IEdly2;
reg irqActive;

wire        link_ck5, link_ck7;
assign link_ck = link_ck5 | link_ck7;

wire        linkclr5, linkclr7;
assign linkclr = linkclr5 | linkclr7;

wire        linkcml5;
assign linkcml = linkcml5;

wire    clr7;
assign clr = clr7;

wire       rot2ac4, rot2ac7;
assign rot2ac = rot2ac4 | rot2ac7;

wire      ac_ck4, ac_ck7;
assign ac_ck = ac_ck4 | ac_ck7;

wire      pc_ck0, pc_ck3;
assign pc_ck = pc_ck0 | pc_ck3;

wire     done0, done1, done2, done3, done4, done5, done7;
assign done = done0 | done1 | done2 | done3 | done4 | done5 | done7;

wire instSKON = (EN & (IR == 3'o0));
wire instION = (EN & (IR == 3'o1));
wire instIOF = (EN & (IR == 3'o2));
wire instSRQ = (EN & (IR == 3'o3));
wire instGTF = (EN & (IR == 3'o4));
wire instRTF = (EN & (IR == 3'o5));
wire instSGT = (EN & (IR == 3'o6));    
wire instCAF = (EN & (IR == 3'o7));

wire AC8 = ~AC[8];

always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
  if (reset) begin 
    IE <= 0; 
    IEdly1 <= 0; 
    IEdly2 <= 0; 
    irqActive <= 0; 
  end else begin
    if (ckFetch & ~stbFetchA & ~stbFetchB & preIrq) begin 
      irqActive <= 1; 
    end
    if (stb1 & instCAF) begin 
      IE <= 0; 
      IEdly1 <= 0; 
      IEdly2 <= 0; 
    end
    if (stb1 & instIOF) begin 
      IE <= 0; 
      IEdly1 <= 0; 
      IEdly2 <= 0; 
    end
    if (stb1 & instSKON) begin 
      IE <= 0; 
      IEdly1 <= 0; 
      IEdly2 <= 0; 
    end
    if (stb1 & instRTF) begin 
      IE <= AC8; 
      IEdly1 <= AC8; 
      IEdly2 <= AC8; 
    end
    if (stb1 & instION) begin 
      IE <= 1; 
      IEdly1 <= 1; 
      IEdly2 <= 1; 
    end
    if (anyDone & IEdly1) begin 
      IEdly1 <= 0; 
    end
    if (anyDone & IEdly2 & ~IEdly1) begin 
      IEdly2 <= 0; 
    end
    if (anyDone & GIE & irqActive) begin 
      IE <= 0; 
      irqActive <= 0; 
    end
  end
end

wire GIE = IE & ~IEdly1 & ~IEdly2;
wire preIrq = GIE & irqRq;
assign irqOverride = preIrq & (irqActive | ~ckFetch);

assign pc_ck0 = instSKON & stb1 & IE;           
assign done0 = instSKON & ck2;

assign done1 = instION & ck2;                  
assign done2 = instIOF & ck2;                  

assign pc_ck3 = instSRQ & stb1 & irqRq;         
assign done3 = instSRQ & ck2;

reg IF = 0;       
reg [2:0] DF = 0; 
reg GT = 0;       
reg II = 0;       
reg U = 0;       

assign rot2ac4 = instGTF & ck1;                  
assign ACGTF = instGTF & ck1 ? {LINK, GT, irqRq, II, IE , U, 1'b0, IF, 1'b0, DF} : 12'b0;
assign ACclr = instGTF & ck1;
assign ac_ck4 = instGTF & stb1;
assign done4 = instGTF & ck2;

assign linkclr5 = instRTF & ck1;                  
assign linkcml5 = instRTF & ck1 & AC[11]; 
assign link_ck5 = instRTF & stb1;
assign done5 = instRTF & ck2;

assign rot2ac7 = instCAF & ck1;                  
assign clr7 = instCAF & ck1;
assign linkclr7 = instCAF & ck1;
assign ac_ck7 = instCAF & stb1;
assign link_ck7 = instCAF & stb1;
assign done7 = instCAF & ck2;

endmodule
